text.p: These were the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's news report on Thursday at noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lithuania and Poland's points of view towards NATO expansion are absolutely the same, Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius said after meeting with Polish Defence Minister Stanislav Dobzhanski.
- Representatives from 16 youth organisations handed over thier resolution to parliamentary chairman Vytautas Landsbergis supporting the country's bid to join NATO.

- Parliament passed a law on Thursday obliging people suspected of dubious business or criminal activities to declare their souces of income and to prove that the property was acquired in a legal way.
